title: Core's hooks ask only susi-tools, and read its claims
goal: Core's hooks fell back to any susi-commercial or susi on PATH for workflow checks; on CachyOS that is a stale 3.1.5 build that still acts on the primary checkout. susi-tools now answers guard and reuse (Susi T-CLAUDE-67). Ask only it, let the post-hooks find nothing to run, and read claims where susi-tools keeps them.
